findings.title: FileSystem methods return Result instead of Promise
findings.evidence:
writeFile: (p: string, v: string | Uint8Array) =>
      attempt(() => write(p, bytes(v))),
findings.explanation: The FileSystem interface expects asynchronous methods returning Promise<Result>. writeFile, appendFile, truncateFile, renameFile and remove are defined as synchronous functions returning a Result directly. Callers that await these methods will receive a non‑Promise value, leading to a TypeError at runtime. Convert these methods to async functions (e.g., async (p,v)=>await attempt(...)) or wrap the Result in Promise.resolve.
